## Access-Review (Certification) Campaign: API Call Sequence

### Step 0 — Get a Bearer Token

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/oauth/token
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

grant_type=client_credentials
&client_id={your_pat_client_id}
&client_secret={your_pat_client_secret}
```

> Always send credentials in the **body**, never in the query string. The token is valid for 1 hour. Rate limit is 100 requests per token per 10 s.

---

### Step 1 — Create the Campaign

Campaigns start in `STAGING` status; you define the type, scope, deadline, and reviewers here.

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/campaigns
Authorization: Bearer {token}
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "name": "Q3 2026 Manager Review",
  "description": "Quarterly access certification for all employees",
  "type": "MANAGER",                   // MANAGER | SOURCE_OWNER | SEARCH | ROLE_COMPOSITION
  "deadline": "2026-08-31T23:59:59Z",
  "emailNotificationEnabled": true,
  "recommendationsEnabled": true,
  "mandatoryCommentRequirement": "REVOCATION_REQUEST_COMMENTS_REQUIRED"
}
```

**Required body fields:** `name`, `description`, `type`

**Key optional fields by campaign type:**
| Type | Scoping field |
|---|---|
| `MANAGER` | _(implicit — all manager/direct-report pairs)_ |
| `SOURCE_OWNER` | `sourceOwnerCampaignInfo` |
| `SEARCH` | `searchCampaignInfo.query` |
| `ROLE_COMPOSITION` | `roleCompositionCampaignInfo` |

The response returns a campaign object with an `id` — save it for all subsequent calls.

---

### Step 2 — Activate (Start) the Campaign

The campaign must be in `STAGED` status. This submits an async job that generates individual reviewer certifications.

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/campaigns/{id}/activate
Authorization: Bearer {token}
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "timeZone": "America/Chicago"    // optional; controls deadline display for reviewers
}
```

The campaign transitions to `ACTIVE`. ISC creates one **certification** (work item) per reviewer.

---

### Step 3 — Pull In-Progress Results

There are two complementary approaches: **per-certification drill-down** and **campaign reports**.

#### 3a. List certifications for the campaign

```http
GET https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/certifications
    ?campaignRef.id={campaign-id}
    &limit=250
    &offset=0
Authorization: Bearer {token}
```

This returns each reviewer's certification object, including `phase` (`STAGED`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `COMPLETED`), `completedItems`, `totalItems`.

#### 3b. Get items within a single certification

```http
GET https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/certifications/{certificationId}/identity-review-items
    ?limit=250
    &filters=completed+eq+false     // optional: show only pending items
Authorization: Bearer {token}
```

Each item shows the identity, entitlement/role/account, and the reviewer's decision (`APPROVE`, `REVOKE`, or undecided).

#### 3c. Get available campaign-level reports (aggregate results)

```http
GET https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/campaigns/{id}/reports
Authorization: Bearer {token}
```

Returns metadata on which report types are available (e.g., `CAMPAIGN_COMPOSITION`, `CAMPAIGN_REMEDIATION_STATUS`).

#### 3d. Run a campaign report

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/campaigns/{id}/run-report/{type}
Authorization: Bearer {token}
```

`{type}` values: `CAMPAIGN_COMPOSITION`, `CAMPAIGN_REMEDIATION_STATUS`. Triggers an async report generation job; download the result once complete.

---

### Scope Summary

| Operation | Required Scope | Min User Level |
|---|---|---|
| Create campaign | `idn:campaign:manage` | ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN |
| Activate campaign | `idn:campaign:manage` | ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN |
| Get/run reports | `idn:campaign-report:read` or `:manage` | ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN, REPORT_ADMIN |
| List certifications/items | `idn:certification:read` | ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN |

---
